_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for closed-loop-vref-pvt-boxtc on the `klt sim` harness (issue #273). Mechanics: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py; argument: this file.
Claim: The box-method temperature coefficient of the closed-loop vref across the full 120-point PVT grid (5 processes x 8 temperatures x 3 supplies), through the co-simulated closed-loop schematic (bandgap_core + bandgap_amp + bandgap_startup) with the TRIM-BEARING core at trim_code=128 (#229, refreshed by #264; solver convergence aids rshunt/gmin dropped). Box TC per (corner, vdd) group from the 8 settled vref points via the -boxtc.csv companion: box = (vmax-vmin)/(span*v27), span = 165 C. NOT a claim against a ratified spec row -- the ratified box-TC row's evidence lives in sim/closed-loop-vref-boxtc-trim (#269).
Netlist provenance: design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice (trim-bearing, trim_code=128), design/netlist/bandgap_amp.spice and design/netlist/bandgap_startup.spice, carried verbatim into sim/closed-loop-vref-pvt-boxtc/testbench/closed_loop_vref_pvt_boxtc.body.spice.tmpl (XMSENSE w= read from the live startup netlist).
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
